title: Fixed Extended Two Link Wall Display
description: One newly authored complete static extended wall-display assembly. A thick connected wall plate has four actual through slots and paired full pivot forks. Two distinct horizontal articulated arms meet three vertical pivot barrels in a zigzag extended arrangement. A whole terminal U yoke, horizontal pitch axle, rear cross mount and local boss carry a complete wide recessed screen housing with an opaque blank inset panel. One continuous fixed rear cable route completes the exterior. Unlike the grounded stem-and-shade task lamp or base-hinged portable computer, the support runs from a vertical mounting plate through two separated yaw joints and a terminal pitch seat to a broad upright display. No old screen or bracket mesh reused. Three opaque constant PBR roles, metre game units, native Z-up, horizontal bounds-centred isolated mounting datum. One prop, zero scenes, no host wall or installation fasteners. Static art only: no signal, display operation, wiring, joint motion, full-travel clearance, mounting compatibility, load capacity, installation, manufacture or safety certification is claimed.
